scope: Read full new module and labels integration, designed and implemented synthetic adversarial tests, read real source-bound policy and verified it using only4407blinded reports. No clinical review/gold access, production edits or publication.

verified_fixes.initial_finding: Joint top-level hash links previously admitted missing, unrelated or disagreeing pair records.
verified_fixes.resolution: Requires exactly one record per pair UID, matching source report hash and explicit false material disagreement. Rehashed missing/wrong/duplicate/disagreement tests pass.

verified_fixes.initial_finding: Whitespace aliases could make copied assessor IDs appear distinct.
verified_fixes.resolution: Blank or untrimmed identity is rejected and exact identities must differ; whitespace-alias tests pass.

verified_fixes.initial_finding: Source-first and acceptance admission needed structured representation rather than interpretation of arbitrary prose.
verified_fixes.resolution: Requires accepted status and exact two-role source-first attestation, with preserved source disclosure lineage. Missing/contrary admission tests pass.

tests.scope: Entire new file, synthetic labels and sources. CLI tests mock unrelated validation gates while exercising real similarity inspection, union/quarantine and export.

remaining_limitations: Source-first admission is an explicit evidence-bound attestation, not proof obtained from arbitrary prose or authentication of real-world identity.
Only registered exact single redundant full-stop relations are supported; no fuzzy or global punctuation matching.
Source similarity is leakage control only, not shared patient/site/pixel identity or clinical correspondence.
Whole repository suite, archive consistency and publication remain root responsibilities.
